page.overview:
Who is A Lo1181?

A_Lo1181 is a downloadable Ghost Duelist in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007.

The player who used A_Lo1181 came third in the 2007 DS World Championship tournament. michel and cladOr players came first and second respectively. Their characters were made available as downloadable opponents in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007.
